messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem  the limited rollout last night spiked p95 for search-write around 02:11-02:17 UTC. we need ownership for: auto-rollback (mvp), default flag blast-radius, canary gating, and recurrence analysis.

alex: agree  keep scope small. i'll create an epic and link the inc. can we aim for scaffolding PRs this sprint?

tasha: i'll take flag defaults. proposal: new feature flags default to server-enforced audience_pct=1 and max_active_users=1000. opt-in annotation required for wider rollout. i'll draft a migration to clamp existing flags.

samir: i'll own canary gating. sketch: sliding 5m window monitor for p50/p95/errors. abort soft if p95 > baseline*1.25 for 5m OR error_rate > baseline*1.15. soft rollback = route traffic off variant; hard rollback = revert after 3m no recovery.

kevin: agree on soft+hard stages. soft rollback automatic and non-disruptive. hard rollback requires approvals. infra to add POST /rollouts/{id}/soft_rollback and CLI simulate command for tests. propose env var ROLLOUT_KILL_SWITCH=disabled default + RBAC controls.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-12-10T02:10:00Z started release/limited-search-idx

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-99 created (limited rollout latency spike)

tasha: sample flag snippet i'll add to repo and gist: {"flag":"search-index-v2","default_audience_pct":1,"max_active_users":1000,"enforcement":"server","opt_out_annotation":"allow_wide"}

samir: gating pseudo-rule i'll add to controller: if p95_window>=5m and p95_now>baseline_p95*1.25 => trigger_soft_rollback(); if soft_active && not recovered 3m => trigger_hard_rollback();

alex: timeline ask: soft-rollback + alerts in 2 sprints; hard rollback + approval flow in 4 sprints. owners: samir (gating), kevin (plumbing), tasha (flag policy). weekly sync to track.

maria: tentative dates: flag default+migration -> 2026-12-20 (tasha); soft rollback MVP -> 2026-12-27 (kevin+samir); hard rollback/workflow -> 2027-01-17 (kevin); recurrence analysis + checklist -> 2026-12-22 (maria). i'll update the epic and add jira tasks.

kevin: will open a demo PR with rollback API and smoke test. CLI sim: rctl rollout simulate --id tmp --p95-mult 1.3

samir: i'll add a canary dashboard and PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-controller/pull/1250 (wip). includes metric hooks and action handlers.

tasha: will add unit/integration tests and migration to clamp flags. also propose a per-customer cap as follow-up (default 1000).

maria: action items consolidated: update tickets with owners/due dates, post PR links in epic, schedule short sync. ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:

alex: tagging @eng-oncall for visibility.

oncall-bot: reminder: oncall rotation starts 2026-12-13.
